variants.prompt: Why do large recommenders retrieve candidates before applying a rich ranker?
options: Scoring the entire catalog with expensive features and models would exceed the request budget
Candidate retrieval removes every cold start
variants.explanation: Cheap retrieval narrows millions of items to a feasible set. A richer model can then spend its latency budget where it matters.
optionFeedback: Cheap retrieval narrows millions of items to a feasible set. A richer model can then spend its latency budget where it matters.

variants.hint: Think about the key idea first: It matters because a product cannot richly score every item in a catalog on every request, and the items it recommends determine which future labels it gets to observe.
